svg.text: Each party has its own column. ReleaseGate is the teal column with its parts inside. Every teal arrow is a request entering the pod web service.
CI/CD PIPELINE ON GITHUB OR SIMILAR
Build the release, make the SBOM,
Pull a stored SBOM when asked
Record a submission or a fix
Get a report draft, then submit
it to the authority by hand
Request into the pod web service
Handled by a person, never by ReleaseGate
Still open are the vulnerability source, database engine, alert channel, final endpoint paths and SBOM replace or keep
